title: Fail closed without advertising the API
text:
Symptom / ask: Unknown callers probe private APIs.
Cause: Informative 401/403 bodies confirm an endpoint exists.
Do: For private LAN/Tailscale services, deny unknown peers with a blank or generic 404 and require positive identity + secret.
Don't: Return detailed auth errors to unauthenticated internet/LAN strangers.
Pointer: home-hosted APIs, admin panels, media engines.

title: Host networking when identity needs the host stack
text:
Symptom / ask: Container cannot resolve peer identity via host VPN/Tailscale WhoIs.
Cause: Bridge networking hides the host network namespace; LocalAPI/WhoIs sees the wrong traffic.
Do: Use host networking (or equivalent) when auth depends on host Tailscale/VPN identity; bind to the intended interface, not 0.0.0.0 for private services.
Don't: Expect Docker Desktop bridge + WhoIs to behave like Linux host Tailscale.
Pointer: Tailscale-gated services, VPN-aware apps.

title: Wipe derived caches after pipeline args change
text:
Symptom / ask: Clients break after changing transcoder/ffmpeg/segment args.
Cause: Old derived segments/artifacts keep serving under the same cache keys.
Do: After changing encode/remux arguments, wipe or version the derived cache.
Don't: Assume new code automatically invalidates on-disk media caches.
Pointer: HLS/transcode caches, any regenerated asset pipeline.

title: VPN sidecar restart strands dependent containers
text:
Symptom / ask: Downloader loses network after restarting the VPN container alone.
Cause: App joined the VPN container network namespace; restart creates a new namespace.
Do: Recreate/restart the dependent service with the VPN (compose profile up), and refuse new downloads when VPN health is down.
Don't: Restart only gluetun/VPN and expect qBittorrent/clients to keep working.
Pointer: gluetun + sidecars, network_mode: service:vpn patterns.
